extracted.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cornflake Cookies
extracted.description: Sweet chocolate chips, salty peanut butter, and crunchy cornflakes combine in this quick and easy, three-ingredient recipe for no-bake cookies.
instruction_lines: Line a baking sheet with waxed paper.
Combine chocolate chips and peanut butter in a saucepan over low heat; cook and stir until melted, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in cornflakes until coated.
Drop 12 spoonfuls of cornflake mixture onto the prepared baking sheet. Chill in the refrigerator until cool, about 30 minutes.
